! Game text
| Jabba’s Prize is a Light Side card and does not count towards your deck limit (but subtracts one from the number of cards you may place under your Starting Effect). Reveal to opponent when deploying your Starting Effect{{Errata hl|1=. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Maintenance]}} ''{{Errata hl|1=Falcon''}}. ''Deploys only at start of game if Jabba’s Prize is at Security Tower (replaces opponent’s Jabba’s Prize imprisoned in Security Tower); otherwise place out of play.'' May not be placed in Reserve Deck. Jabba’s Prize is a persona of Corran Horn only while on table. If Jabba’s Prize was just released or leaves table, place it out of play. While Jabba’s Prize {{Errata hl|1=is}} at Audience Chamber, opponent’s battle destiny draws there are +1.  ||  Jabba's Prize is a Light Side card and does not count {{Errata hl|1=toward}} your deck limit (but subtracts one from the number of cards you may {{Errata hl|1=start}} under your Starting Effect). == Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Jabba's Prize]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Jabba's Prize (Errata 3)]] shares the [[Jabba's Prize (Errata 2)]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
